name: merge-request-review
description: A GitLab merge request review workflow for Claude Code. It loads existing discussions first, checks MR-backed verification state, stores durable .workflow/mr-reviews artifacts through its MCP, dispatches merge_request_* reviewer subagents, drafts fixed-format review notes, and approves only after blocking findings are resolved. Requires an external GitLab MCP for GitLab reads/writes.
